strong: Re-Elect South Pasadena City Councilmember Michael Cacciotti

text: I'm honored to have had the privilege of helping make South Pasadena an even better place to live, and I'm excited to help secure a bright future for our city.
In service to our city, I've helped:

- Prevent traffic congestion from the 710 freeway extension
- Stop the sale of our South Pasadena Nature Park
- Spearhead the Arroyo Seco Pedestrian/Bicycle path
- Improve library, senior, and recreational programs

Before I leave public service, I want to secure the achievements we've made for South Pasadena and continue improving the quality of life for our residents.

- Maintain high levels of public safety
- Increase bike and pedestrian safety
- Improve the city services you depend on (Streets, sidewalks, water & sewer systems)

text: South Pasadena is where my family chose to build our life and raise our children. I am running for City Council to bring leadership to the community we love. As Chair of the South Pasadena Finance Commission, I have worked to strengthen financial oversight, promote transparency, and protect taxpayer dollars. As Executive Vice

President, Chief People Officer and General Counsel for the YMCA of Metropolitan Los Angeles, I help oversee legal, financial, workforce, and operational matters for an organization with a budget and complexity comparable to our City.

Beyond my work, I coach Jr. Clippers basketball and Little League, chaired the Marengo Parent Party, serve on the AbilityFirst and SPEF boards, and am a member of South Pasadena DUDES and the Oneonta Club.

On the City Council, I will focus on restoring financial stability, repairing roads and sidewalks, improving neighborhood safety, investing in parks for every generation, and creating a walkable downtown that supports local businesses and welcomes new ones.

I am honored to have support from leaders affiliated with SPEF, Marengo PTA, the Oneonta Club, South Pasadena DUDES, and the Chinese American Society. I will listen, act with urgency, unite the community, and deliver results. I ask for your vote.
